hints.mirrorMode: When enabled, the model will be mirrored horizontally.
hints.mouseMirror: When enabled, the mouse will mirror the hand movement.
hints.highlightAllHeldKeys: Highlight all held keys without changing paw movements. Applies to built-in standard and keyboard models for both cats. Custom models keep their original display.
hints.ignoreMouse: When enabled, the model will not respond to mouse events. Useful for keyboard mode or gamepad mode.
hints.motionSound: When enabled, the model will play corresponding sound effects when performing actions (if they exist).
hints.behavior: When enabled, motions and expressions can be configured and triggered.
hints.passThrough: When enabled, clicks pass through the window without affecting it.
hints.alwaysOnTop: When enabled, the window stays above all other windows.
hints.keepInScreen: When enabled, the window automatically stays within the screen boundaries.
hints.windowSize: Move mouse to window edge, or hold Shift and right-drag to resize.
hints.autoReleaseDelay: On Windows, some system keys cannot capture release events and will auto-release after timeout.
hints.hideOnHover: When enabled, the window hides automatically on mouse hover. You can set a delay; 0 means hide immediately.
hints.maxFPS: Limit the maximum frame rate for model rendering. Lowering the frame rate can reduce CPU/GPU usage.

hints.showTaskbarIcon: When enabled, the window can be captured via OBS Studio.
hints.showTrayIcon: When enabled, the app icon is displayed in the system tray.
hints.inputMonitoringPermission: Enable input monitoring to receive keyboard and mouse events from the system.
hints.inputMonitoringPermissionGuide:
Input Monitoring permission is required for the app to receive keyboard and mouse events from the system.

Steps:
1. Open System Settings → Privacy & Security → Input Monitoring.
2. If BongoCat already appears in the list, select it and click the "-" button to remove it.
3. Click the "+" button to find and add BongoCat.
4. Restart the app for the permission to take effect.
hints.administratorPermission: Running the app as administrator helps capture some system-level keys and input events more reliably.
hints.administratorPermissionGuide:
To capture some system-level keys and input events more reliably, it is recommended to run the app as administrator.

How to do it:
1. Exit the app first.
2. Find the app exe or its shortcut in File Explorer.
3. Choose how to launch:
   • One-time: Right-click and choose "Run as administrator".
   • Always (default): Right-click → Properties → Compatibility tab → check "Run this program as an administrator" → OK.

hints.enabled: Once on, fill in the three values below and press Connect. Turning it off disconnects immediately and stops all data sharing.
hints.chatOverlay: Show bubbles, input and the microphone above your cat. Turning it off reclaims that space; the separate chat window remains available.
hints.syncModel: Shares model names only, never files. Import the peer's model locally and give it the same name. Missing models fall back to your own. Name older imports using the pencil on the Models page. Both clients need an updated version.
hints.missingPeerModel: Peer model “{name}” is missing or unavailable. Using your model. Place their model files locally and import them; for existing imports, set matching names on the Models page.
hints.connectSteps: The order is: fill in the three values above → press Connect → then turn on "Partner's Cat" and "Chat Window" further down (both start off).
hints.missingRelayUrl: The server address is still missing: type it into "Server Address" (or ask your partner for it), then press Connect.
hints.missingSecret: The pairing key is still missing: it must match your partner's, and goes into "Pairing Key".
hints.errorHowTo: It is almost always one of these three: wrong address / wrong password / the server is not running.
hints.stunUrls: One per line; leave it empty to use the built-in list. It only applies to pairing-code links — with a server, STUN / TURN comes from the server and this is unused.
hints.relayUrl: The pairing server both sides use, for example cat.example.com. A self-hosted server without a certificate can be a plain IP, for example 123.123.123.123:8080. If you deployed it yourself, this is the address the deployment printed. A public server someone opened up for everyone goes in this field too (its password goes in Server Password below).
hints.pairSecret: The same pairing key on both sides puts you in the same two-person session. Ask your partner for theirs, or press Generate and send one over. It is kept in the system credential vault.
hints.displayName: The name your partner sees in the chat window title and on the remote cat. Click Save and it updates on their side right away; leave it empty to show "Partner".
hints.retryAfterSave: Updated. Press Connect to try again.
hints.relayUrlUnsaved: The address was changed. Press Save to apply it.
hints.credentialUnsaved: Changed. Press Save to apply it.
hints.relayUrlEmpty: The server address cannot be empty — an empty box has no effect. To change it, type a new address and press Save.
hints.serverPassword: Not needed with the official Cloudflare relay. Only for a self-hosted server: whoever deployed it set a password there, and both of you must enter the same value. Without it you cannot connect (it keeps strangers from freeloading). If someone gave you a public-server password (a server opened up to help anyone punch through), put it here too: that server only helps you connect and does not relay chat or files.

serverKeyTier.full: This server says: your key is the full tier (punch-through plus relay fallback).
serverKeyTier.public: This server says: your key is the public tier — it only borrows the server to punch through and never relays, so if punching fails nothing can be sent.

hints.valuesRemembered: Saved the values you entered; they will be used again on next launch
hints.valuesReplaced: Saved the values you entered and replaced the pairing key that was stored before. The old key no longer works, so your partner has to switch to this one too or you will not connect.
hints.deleteSecretBody: Once deleted this key cannot be read back — you will have to ask your partner to send it again.
hints.deleteServerPasswordBody: Once deleted you will have to ask whoever deployed the server for it again.
hints.plaintextServer: This server does not use HTTPS/WSS: the connection handshake is not protected by TLS, and someone on the same network could tell that you are pairing. Switch to an https address if you can.
hints.secretGenerated: Generated a new pairing key and copied it to the clipboard. Send it to the other person, then save.
hints.secretGeneratedNotCopied: Generated a new pairing key, but copying it failed. Use Copy to send it, then save.
hints.lastErrorNoAddress: Never connected yet, so there is no address
hints.fingerprint: Both sides should show exactly the same fingerprint (read your partner's out loud to compare — never read the key itself):
hints.autoConnect: Connect automatically when the app starts.
hints.remoteCat: Show your partner's cat in a separate desktop window.
hints.remoteModel: Leave empty to use the same model as your own cat. Only models installed locally can be chosen.
hints.remoteStats: Shown when you hover over your partner's cat (always shown while Pass Through is on). Requires your partner to enable "Share Input Stats" as well.
hints.chatWindow: Show the chat window (bubbles) on the desktop.
hints.bubbleCount: Up to 3 messages above the cat. The separate chat window scrolls continuously through history.
hints.chatPassThrough: When enabled the chat window lets clicks through; opening the text box temporarily disables it.
hints.notificationSound: Play a short sound when a message from your partner arrives.
hints.attachmentLimit: Size limit for a single file. Each side uses its own limit, up to 1024 MB.
hints.chatHistory: Chat history lives on your own computer only (the server keeps none); export it to keep a copy.
hints.historyLimit: Used for the progress hint only — reaching the limit never deletes messages automatically.
hints.exportFormat: JSON is best for backups, TXT / Markdown is easy to read.
hints.exportChat: Export all locally stored chat messages into one file.
hints.deleteOldOnReset: When off (default) the previous cycle's records stay on this device, they just stop showing in the chat window.
hints.newEpoch: Export the current records and start a new cycle; the chat window is cleared accordingly.
hints.historyNear: Local chat history is close to the storage limit. Consider exporting and starting a new cycle.
hints.historyFull: Local chat history reached the storage limit. Please export and start a new cycle.
hints.newEpochTitle: Export and start a new cycle?
hints.newEpochKeepOld: The current records are exported to the file you pick, then a new cycle starts. Old records stay on this device.
hints.newEpochDeleteOld: The current records are exported to the file you pick, then a new cycle starts and the local old records are deleted.
hints.shareTypingActivity: Shares the hand side, typing intensity and the actual key names, so your partner's cat presses the same keys. Only keys with artwork in the model are sent.
hints.sharePointer: Only the pointer's screen ratio and button state are shared, never real coordinates.
hints.shareInputStats: On by default. When enabled, your partner sees today's and total input counts — still just numbers.
hints.pauseActivitySync: Temporarily stop sending typing and mouse activity. Chat and presence stay available.
hints.stats: Stats are stored locally; they are only sent when "Share Input Stats" is enabled.
hints.peerStatsDate: Shared by your partner. Statistics date: {date} (their local date).
hints.peerStatsPrivate: Your partner has not enabled "Share Input Stats".
hints.peerStatsWaiting: Waiting for your partner's statistics. They need to enable "Share Input Stats".
hints.autoReturn: Starts watching after 5 seconds without input; typing, clicking, or a noticeable mouse move then ends the away state.
hints.awayMessage: This text is shown above your cat for your partner while you are away.
hints.sendSystemNotice: Flash "your partner is back" on the remote cat window when your partner stops being away.
hints.presence: Your partner will see that you stepped away.

placeholders.serverPassword: The password set when the server was deployed

p2p.label: P2P Channel
p2p.hint: If a direct link works, pet state and input stats travel directly between the two computers instead of through the server. If it fails everything falls back to the server unchanged.
p2p.hintPublic: This is a public server: it only helps the two of you punch through and does not relay chat, voice or attachments — so until the link is up (shown as "Direct"), seeing your partner online is all you get. If it never connects, switch to another server or ask your partner to use a different network (this tier has no relay to fall back on). Your own server can be opened to others too: just set a public password on it.
p2p.failedPublic: Hole punching failed: the public tier only borrows this server to punch through and never relays — nothing can be sent right now

manual.label: Pairing Code (no server)
manual.hint: Each computer makes one code and you send them to each other — no server involved at all. The trade-off: until the link is up, the partner cat, chat, attachments and voice are unavailable.
manual.limits: This route skips the server, so the code carries your machine's network addresses (encrypted; only someone with the same pairing key can open it). Send it only to the person you are pairing with.
manual.sendToPeer: Send the code above to your partner (any messenger; copy the whole thing).
manual.sendBack: Send the code above back to the computer that generated it — it starts connecting as soon as they paste it in.
manual.pastePlaceholder: Paste the pairing code your partner sent
manual.expired: This code has expired — generate a new one
manual.fewCandidates: This code only carries local addresses (STUN did not find a public one), so it will most likely only work on the same Wi-Fi.

phase.offer-ready: Waiting for your partner to paste this code back
phase.answer-ready: Send this code back to your partner (they should paste it in soon)
